Coram : G.P. MATHUR*, DALVEER BHANDARI
Hindu law: Hindu Marriage Act, 1955; Section 9: Wife tortured by her husband and in-laws-She was driven out of her matrimonial home along with her minor child-Criminal "Complaint-Filing of a petition by her husband in a District Court for restitution of conjugal rights-Filing of Transfer setting out terms of compromise-Held: Marriage has been wrecked beyond the hope of salvage­ Under the circumstances, it is appropriate to declare defunct dejure the marriage as it is defunct in defecto-All the pending cases between the parties disposed of and a quietus is put to litigation
Decision Date : 20-11-2006 | Case No : TRANSFER PETITION (CIVIL) No. 228/2004 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
